h:
这是初学者的 Wan 2.2 工作流程。它设计简单，易于上手。文档全部包含在左侧的工作流程中。

关于1.1版本：

解决了分辨率问题。以前的版本不遵守 WAN 2.2 的 64 像素倍数。现在，它可以确保您以正确的分辨率开始，并避免出现边缘幻象。通过简单的切换，您可以在两者之间进行选择，而不是几个布尔值。

特点：

所有主要控制装置都位于集中位置。

自动调整图像大小，只需粘贴即可

选择 16、32 或 64 fps。

快速升级或使用流行的高档型号（Remacri 或任何您喜欢的）

CFG、目标分辨率、要保存的最后一帧图像数量、放大系数、西格玛偏移，甚至慢动作的滑块。

使用最后一帧和种子创建提示存档。

可与基础 Wan 2.2 模型和 Dasiwa Snatchkiss 配合使用——只需在使用内置 LoRA 的模型时关闭闪电 LoRA 即可！

制作人员

CivitAI 上的创建者和许多人花了很多时间来创建资源并免费共享它们，我希望以同样的方式参与其中，这就是为什么我创建自己的模型和资源。此外，还有一些创作者帮助过我、指导过我，或者我借用了他们的创作。

该工作流程最初取自老板X富豪我喜欢他个人 WAN2.2 工作流程的布局（顺便说一句，他是一位多产的 NSFW 创建者，这一切看起来都很棒）和 16/32/64 fps 的东西，但我觉得它需要一个快速的旁路器。很快，我发现自己不断地进行调整，并对每个角落和缝隙进行故障排除，试图使这个工作流程成为我自己的工作流程。几天之内，我就出现了一些几乎认不出来的东西。

组件被提升自Fatberg_Slim的工作流程这是我有一段时间的主要工作。如果我遇到困难或有疑问，我会先到这里。

感谢孤猫，Lone Catone 23rd，如果你不喜欢简洁的话。 Lonecat 知道别人不知道的事情，并且给了我很棒的帮助，当然其中大部分都已经融入到了这个工作流程中。

感谢暗行者创造了令人惊叹的工作流程，真正配得上“旗舰”或母舰的称号！我从使用它们中学到了很多东西！

这仍然是测试版，如果您发现任何问题或建议改进，请发表评论或私信。

o.en:
This is intended as a beginner's Wan 2.2 workflow. It's got a simple design and makes it easy to get started. The documentation is all included in the workflow on the left side.

About Version 1.1:

Resolution woes resolved. Previous versions did not adhere to the 64 pixel multiple for WAN 2.2. Now it ensures you start at the right resolution and avoid phantasms on the edges. A simple toggle lets you choose between the two instead of a couple of Booleans.

Features:

All main controls in a centralized location.

Automatically resizes images, just paste and go

Select 16, 32, or 64 fps.

Upscale either quick or with a popular upscale model (Remacri or whatever you prefer)

Sliders for CFG, Target resolution, number of lastframe images to save, upscale factor, sigma shift, even slo-mo.

Creates a prompt archive with lastframe and seed.

Works with the base Wan 2.2 model and with Dasiwa Snatchkiss -- just turn off the lightning LoRAs when using a model that has them baked in!

Credits

The creators on CivitAI and so many have devoted so many hours to creating resources and sharing them for free, and I wish to participate in kind, and that's why I create models and resources of my own. Furthermore, there are creators that have helped me, instructed me, or whose creations I have borrowed from.

This workflow was originally taken fromBossXRichI liked the layout of his personal WAN2.2 workflow (he is a prolific NSFW creator btw, and it all looks great) and the 16/32/64 fps thing, but I felt like it needed a fast bypasser. Soon I found myself making tweak after tweak and troubleshooting every nook and cranny trying to make this workflow into something I could call my own. Within a few days I had something barely recognizable.

Components were lifted fromFatberg_Slim'sworkflowwhich was my main for a while. If I ran into a snag or had a question, I went here first.

Thanks toLonecat, Lone Catone the 23rd if you're not into the whole brevity thing. Lonecat knows things no one else does, and has given me awesome help, and surely much of that has gone into this workflow.

Thanks toDarksidewalkerfor making amazing workflows, truly deserving of the title of "Flagship" or mothership really! I've learned a lot from using them!

This is still the beta version, just leave a comment or DM if you notice anything is wrong or suggest improvements.
